name: Fallen Down
source:
Good game. I see, once again, you managed to clean the entourage of your dear senpai.

I guess you're happy, Yandere-chan.

But ... as you suspect, I'm afraid your senpai is definitely a tormentor of hearts ...

Since it seems that another girl is falling under her spell and feeling under his own.

What surprises me coming from her elsewhere ...

And something tells me that you will not be able to get rid of her as easily as others ...

Ah! Before I forget, killing boys is a very good strategy. I totally approve.

How? His name ?

Well, um ...

Tell me, Ayano, I know that socializing is not your forte but have you ever heard of a girl named ...

translation:
好游戏。看来你又把你亲爱的学长的随行人员清理干净了。

我猜你很高兴，Yandere-chan。

不过……正如你所怀疑的那样，恐怕你的前辈绝对是一个心灵折磨者……

因为似乎另一个女孩被她的魅力所吸引，并被他自己的魅力所吸引。

令我惊讶的是她在其他地方的表现……

有件事告诉我，你将无法像其他人那样轻易摆脱她……

啊！在我忘记之前，杀死男孩是一个非常好的策略。我完全赞同。

如何？他的名字？

嗯，嗯…

告诉我，绫乃，我知道社交不是你的强项，但是你听说过一个叫……的女孩吗？
